description: This file contains the ContentJsonEvents class, which manages JSON-based operations related to content associations in the OFBiz content management system. It includes methods for retrieving, moving, and deleting content associations, and interacts with various database entities such as ContentAssoc, WebSitePathAlias, and Content. It relies on OFBiz's delegator and transaction utilities, and processes HTTP requests/responses.

classes.name: ContentJsonEvents
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle content association operations such as retrieval, movement, and deletion, primarily for JSON responses.

methods.name: getContentAssocs
methods.description: Retrieves all content associations for a given contentId, sorts them by title, and returns the list as a JSON array in the HTTP response.

methods.name: moveContent
methods.description: Moves a content association from one contentId to another, updating relevant dates within a transaction, and returns the updated association as JSON.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Deletes (sets thruDate) all associations and web path aliases related to a specified contentId.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Helper method to delete associations and aliases for a given contentId, updating their thruDates.

methods.name: deleteWebPathAliases
methods.description: Recursively deletes web path aliases associated with a contentId.

methods.name: getTreeNode
methods.description: Constructs and returns a tree node map for a given content association, including title and attributes.
